patterns.note: Full-bleed, dark-themed content sections with generous vertical spacing, creating distinct visual breaks between content blocks.
Full-screen section transitions where the previous content block slides up or fades out to reveal the next, often with an interstitial brand pattern.
Predominantly black background with white text, creating a high-contrast, sophisticated and minimalist aesthetic.
Consistent use of a clean, modern sans-serif typeface for all text, with subtle variations in weight and size for hierarchy rather than dramatic changes.
A portfolio archive presented as a dense, multi-column text grid with years as primary categories, providing a comprehensive overview of past projects.

technique_notes: The site employs full-screen, scroll-triggered transitions to reveal new content blocks. The initial hero image transitions into a brand-specific pattern screen, which then transitions into the main project content. This creates a distinct, almost chapter-like progression through the page, with the top and bottom navigation elements remaining fixed or reappearing consistently across these full-screen changes.
The hero section utilizes a video-hero component for a dynamic background, overlaid with minimal text and a unique vertical text element that disappears with the hero on scroll.

design_tokens.type_scale: Relatively small body text for details and navigation, with slightly larger, bold headings for project titles, maintaining an understated yet clear hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, with no visible rounded elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with significant vertical padding between major sections and a more dense, but still readable, grid for the portfolio archive.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its dramatic, full-screen scroll-triggered transitions that completely replace the viewport content, often with an interstitial brand pattern, creating a highly cinematic and curated browsing experience that feels like flipping through a high-end magazine.
